publicContract.placement: one admitted host and one workspace lease per run

implementation.command: strict trusted workflow/source digest, JSON input, host, workspace intent, runtime profile, and idempotency admission with deterministic run and stream identities
implementation.runtime: App Server thread/start and turn/start with exact node model and medium effort, normalized runtime events, active turn interruption, and bound thread reconciliation
implementation.workflow: typed phase/parallel/agent/artifact dataflow through the existing provider-neutral executeWorkflow seam with stable frozen node identity
implementation.durability: PostgreSQL control events/artifacts plus pg-boss-owned delivery, retry, restart, and dead-letter timing
implementation.idempotency: exact replay returns the stable run handle; conflicting reuse fails before a duplicate job, thread, turn, or artifact
implementation.terminalLaw: runtime completion is recorded separately; only daemon result/artifact registration advances the durable handle to completed

evidence.boundary: real PostgreSQL, pg-boss, TLS-authenticated WSS, and App Server

adversarialEvidence: raw paths, extra provider choreography, wrong reasoning, and non-JSON input rejected
two real parallel turns and dependent phase ordering
schema-bound values and durable artifact/result observation
accepted pg-boss job survives delivery runtime restart before execution
active bound turn interruption and forbidden downstream start
disconnect reconciles a bound completed thread without duplicate thread/start
runtime terminal cannot race ahead of durable result completion
public events omit prompts, raw workflow input envelopes, credentials, environment, and reasoning

sdkRemoval.requiredCheckpoint: Coordinator replaces the compatibility runner with connectAppServer/createAppServerWorkflowExecutor, removes the production SDK path and dependency, preserves required non-production characterization only where still meaningful, synchronizes bun.lock, and returns a materialized removal checkpoint.
